items.q: What does he call a healthy first-time rate?
items.a: Seven out of ten, without a fight. The kids in his office are at zero to three. Repeat the ask or ignore the miss and the brain keeps the miss.

items.q: What happens if you bring the forgotten homework?
items.a: You will bring it every time. Same for the sweater and the lunch. Tana told Chloe she had already done second grade. Chloe came back in twenty minutes.

items.q: What are the rules of special time?
items.a: Twenty minutes, their reasonable pick, no commands, no questions, no directions. Then repeat what they said, including the feeling. Blue hair can turn into I don't fit in.

items.q: What should you say instead of you're smart?
items.a: You work hard. Smart as an identity falls apart on a hard problem. Effort as an identity makes them work longer.

items.q: What still happens when they treat you badly?
items.a: You feed them. You do not add the nice trip. Ask once, offer the choice, and follow through. Five repeats is how a parent ends up hurting a child.
